title: Standing workspace calculation authorization
description: ADR-0069: a durable permission citizen, decoupled from per-family closure, granting that the current workspace may be treated as the complete input record for a calculation scoped to one taxpayer/subject, one tax year, and one rule-scoped re-authorization boundary digest (universe_id). Not a finding, not a family horizon, and not an Ontology Grant. Workspace identity is the holding act log. A later grant at the same (subject_id, tax_year) supersedes this citizen; suspension and withdrawal are dedicated end acts, not absence.
